question: If an entity's nature is object-manifestation, can it be knowable to only one knower?
premises: An entity is taken to have the nature of object-manifestation.
If such manifestation were unreal, knowability restricted to a single knower would follow.
Knowability by another knower would then be excluded.
inference: Restricting knowability to a single knower conflicts with the nature of manifestation as such.
uncertainties: The exact force of tvasat (unreal as hypothetical or as consequence) is slightly compressed in the verse.
plain_english: If an entity’s very nature were the manifestation of an object, then treating that manifestation as unreal would make it knowable only to one knower and not to any other. This shows the problem with limiting knowability to a single knower.
